## HolyMind Framework
HolyMind is Boom’s framework for goal-directed work, connected capabilities, evidence and verification. The website presents 34 original skill symbols with public concept summaries, grouped into Reason, Build and Verify. Visitors can search the collection and read illustrative use cases. The site does not run the framework or execute agents.

## Reading the website
The interactive workbench contains illustrative architecture sketches and planning briefs. They are not client case studies, performance claims, or a live AI service. No information is submitted by the workbench.
